title: The space of polarized compactifications of an affine variety
summary: Let $X$ be a normal affine variety over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Through the lens of non-Archimedean geometry, we study the space of polarized compactifications of $X$, consisting of pairs $(\bar X, D)$ where $\bar X$ is a normal projective variety containing $X$ as a dense open subset, and $D$ is an effective ample $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier $\mathbb{Q}$-divisor with support equal to the complement of $X$ in $\bar X$.
